test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

She _______ a lot about her health problems.
solution:
The correct answer is- 'worries.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given options:
 
 
• Concerns: to affect or involve somebody/something. (किसी को प्रभावित या शामिल करना; किसी से संबंधित होना)
 
• Troubles: to make somebody worried, upset, etc. (किसी को चिंतित, परेशान आदि कर देना।)
 
• Suffers: to experience something unpleasant, for example pain, sadness, difficulty, etc. (दर्द, विषाद, कठिनाई आदि अप्रिय बातें सहन करना; कष्‍ट भोगना।)
 
• Worries: to think that something bad might happen or has happened. (किसी दुर्घटना की आशंका से चिंतित होना, फ़िक्रमंद होना।)
 
 
 
• Therefore, the word 'worries' should be used as the sentence is talking about the thinking of the subject **'she'** regarding her health.
 
• Correct sentence__:* She **worries** a lot about her health problems.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
